results.title: Content Launch Press
results.description:
Content Launch Press/Captain of Influence is an independent publishing imprint and boutique media platform closely affiliated with Content Launch, a digital marketing agency founded by author and marketer Jon Wuebben. The company specializes in self-publishing, printing, and distributing business-focused literature, marketing strategy guides and thought-leadership books. Its authors are industry experts, corporate leaders and independent entrepreneurs.

Notable books published under this imprint include Future Marketing: Winning in the Prosumer Age and various regional business strategy guides.

Rather than operating as a traditional publisher, Content Launch Press serves as a specialized launchpad for professionals seeking to build authority, generate business leads, and share niche expertise. It helps authors navigate the self-publishing ecosystem by combining editorial production with the digital marketing, content distribution, and SEO expertise of its parent agency.

results.title: “The future of Ghana football will not be secured by chance” – GFA president Kurt Okraku
results.description: Ghana Football Association (GFA) President Kurt Okraku has stressed that the future of Ghana football will depend on deliberate investment, sound policies and a sustained commitment to youth development.Speaking at the GFA’s 32nd Ordinary Congress at the Ghanaman Soccer Centre of Excellence in Prampram on Thursday, Okraku stressed Ghana cannot rely on chance to maintain its rich football tradition, insisting that the country must put in place deliberate measures to identify, nurture and develop the next generation of football talents.“The future of Ghana football will not be secured by chance - it will be built through deliberate investment, sound policy and unwavering commitment,” Okraku said.“That is why today, I am proud to reaffirm our flagship national youth development policy, Power to the Youth,” he added.The policy reflects the GFA’s focus on placing young players at the centre of Ghana’s long-term football development plans.Ghana has a long history of producing talented footballers who have gone on to make significant contributions at both domestic and international levels.
